units.summary: Every admin locale file (packages/core/admin/admin/src/translations/*.json, by stem) has a non-empty native name in languageNativeNames.ts
units.alint: cross_file registered, register_as '{stem}', source translations/*.json, target languageNativeNames.ts read by a regex that takes an entry at a line start or after '{' or ',' with a single- or double-quoted value: strapi-admin-locales-have-native-names
units.reason: R7: a test over files alint reads, classified by its assertion. The TS object literal is read by a regex, not a parser; Stage C widened it for double quotes and two entries on one line, but a template literal, computed value or spread would still be misread, so C (Stage B).
units.fire_verified: Scratch copy: four breaks each fired strapi-admin-locales-have-native-names: a new xx.json, removing the unquoted ca entry, emptying ca to '', and removing the quoted 'pt-BR' entry. Removing 'en-GB' (no en-GB.json) correctly passed. Clone passes (35 locale files).

changes.why: The rule reads languageNativeNames.ts with the line regex `(?m)^\s*'?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z-]*)'?\s*:\s*'[^']+'`, which depends on prettier's single-quoted, one-entry-per-line layout. On a scratch copy, a valid double-quoted value produced a false positive, and prettier itself emits double quotes for a native name that contains an apostrophe. Two entries on one line also misfire. A TS object read by line regex is C (berry-18, strapi-06); R4 confirms only the current layout.
The record text still described the bucket or rule from before Stage B or the integrator changed it.

The check-file filename-naming-convention rule in the admin .eslintrc.cjs files asserts a path name, not source code, so it is a structure invariant alint reads; classifying it D under R2 is wrong. The folder/no-index half cannot be inferred offline: 18 index files carry no disable. Split it out or leave it unverified.

Two stacked version policies: check-package-versions.mjs (lockstep with packages/core/strapi version, same major only) plus syncpack lint restricted to exact specifiers (catalog: and every non-exact range ignored), so ranges are never compared.

Both version tools silently skip dot directories (glob/syncpack default dot:false): .github/actions/community-pr-triage (5.43.0) and draft-release (5.52.3) drift freely, and @actions/github 6.0.0 vs 6.0.1 would be a syncpack mismatch if .github were included.
lockfile-lint (an npm/yarn-classic tool) runs against a Yarn Berry v8 lockfile with a Berry-protocol scheme allowlist (npm:, workspace:, patch:).
The Playwright exact-pin guard exists because the version names the e2e container image (mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v<version>-resolute).

The contributor-docs Docusaurus plugin (docs/plugins/workspace-packages) acts as a repository validator. It throws on unsupported root workspace patterns, unnamed packages/ manifests and unknown package group folders, so monorepo structure is checked by a docs build.
AGENTS.md forbids workspace:* inside packages/ (published packages pin exact semver to each other), the inverse of the common monorepo convention.
engines.node >=22 but the migration_v5 job runs Node 20 (Yarn Berry does not enforce engines); .nvmrc (22) is not read by CI.
lerna.json (version 5.7.0) is vestigial; nx release is used and the real version is 5.62.0.
yarn-nm-install's header comment says enable-corepack defaults to 'false' while the input default is 'true' (stale comment).
Most workflows SHA-pin actions, but draft-release.yml / invalidate-qa-done use tag refs (@v1, @v6, @v9), so there is no SHA-pin policy.

Repository-data assertions live inside jest/vitest suites (native-name coverage, edit-view hint keys, singular/plural pairs, iso-locales uniqueness, exports source paths, e2e spec gating). This is the R7 pattern of tests asserting files.
tags.yml carries its own conventions in a header comment (35 tags max, no package-folder or status tags).
.cursor/worktrees.json is committed while .cursor/, .claude/ and .agents/ are otherwise gitignored; skill link dirs are maintained by yarn ai:sync.

strapi-06: the catalog regex reads .yarnrc.yml by line. An indented key with the same name elsewhere in .yarnrc.yml (e.g. under npmScopes) masks a missing catalog entry, so the rule has a false-negative path. The C bucket is right, and the mask is worth noting.

stage_b_summary: Stage B for strapi/strapi@fcc1df0668527c342de7f8cc5acd331434a2d505. Stage A's 34-rule config validates and checks clean on the clone. I reproduced the fire direction for every A unit in the locale, dep-version and toolchain-pin families on a scratch copy; each one fires when broken and passes on the clone. Missed units (6): - strapi-b01, C (locale): the translation catalogs must be valid JSON for rollup json() and the dynamic imports. alint's JSONC-tolerant reader accepts trailing commas and comments, the element-web-08 relaxation. - strapi-b02, C (locale): CTB en.json privateField.description must equal the attributeOptions.ts defaultMessage. cross_file equals expresses it via a TS regex. - strapi-b03, A (other): every tags.yml entry has a label and a description. The yaml_path_absent root filter fires and passes. - strapi-b04, B-config unique-key (other): workspace names are unique. Yarn and Nx enforce it on every install, and it holds at the pin (60 distinct names). - strapi-b05, B-adapter (other): Docusaurus frontmatter schema, enforced by the docs_build throw. - strapi-b06, D (other): the committed GitHub-action dist bundles are rebuilt from source after a change. A filename convention is a structure invariant, but 40 files are exempt by inline disable. - strapi-48, A to C: CommonMark-only alt checking misses the 13 HTML `` tags (7 multi-line) and .mdx pages. Config issues: - strapi-07 does not enforce the pinned-exact half and leaves out scripts/* and .github/actions/*. - strapi-40's exclude list misses the `other` group. - strapi-01 has scope edges, strapi-06 can mask a missing catalog entry, and strapi-46's threshold is off by 3. - strapi-51 does not check the `package:` frontmatter key. - strapi-04 (lockfile-lint semantics on Berry) and the commitlint preset could not be verified offline. No removals. These are not units: the em-dash, link-anchor, blob/develop, editable-image-source and tests-in-__tests__ conventions are violated at the pin, and description-required applies only to new pages. changes.detail: Scope widened to scripts/*/package.json and .github/actions/*/package.json; AGENTS.md's workspace:* allowlist does not exempt them. Fires on a scratch copy for a workspace:* devDep in scripts/front, a workspace:^ dep in .github/actions/check-pr-status, and a workspace:* peer in packages/core/admin. Passes on the clone, where none of those manifests uses workspace:.

New json_path_matches rule for the pinned-exact half: dependencies and devDependencies of packages/ manifests that name one of the 43 packages/ workspace names must be exact x.y.z (if_present). peerDependencies are left out because all 22 internal peer specifiers are ^5.0.0 at the pin, so the convention does not hold for them (R5). Stage B's '70+112 all exact' count covers deps and devDeps only. Fires on ^5.62.0 (dependency), ~5.62.0 (devDep), >=5.62.0 (vitest-config, last name in the list) and 5.62.x (a name at a folded-line start). The external @strapi/design-system ^2.3.1 passes as a control. Passes on the clone (182 exact specifiers). The workspace names are mirrored by hand, which makes this half C-shaped.

The publishHint test is now !(length(publishHint) > 0), mirroring the test's `.length > 0`, so a null or non-string publishHint is flagged. Fires on a scratch copy of the content-manager translations for: publishHint null, publishHint 5, publishHint removed, publishHint '', and saveHint containing {action}. Removing both keys passes, and so does a whitespace-only publishHint (as in jest). Passes on the clone.

Comment changed to C, per Stage B. The regex now accepts bare, single- or double-quoted keys, single- or double-quoted non-empty values, and entries after `{` or `,`, so two entries on one line count. The limits that remain are listed in the rule comment. Fires on a scratch copy when ca is removed, when 'pt-BR' is emptied, and when the fi entry is commented out. Stage B's false positives now pass: ca: "Catal'à" and two entries on one line with a double-quoted key. Passes on the clone.
Added `other` to the excluded groups (groups.mjs PACKAGE_GROUPS includes it). On a scratch copy packages/other/x/package.json passes and packages/weird/y/package.json fires. Passes on the clone.

The target glob now spells each depth with dot-free [!.]* segments down to 8 directory levels, plus a deeper catch-all, to match glob's dot:false at any depth. Manifests sit at most 5 levels deep at the pin. The global ignore `tests/e2e/data/**` was removed because the script checks those manifests; there are none at the pin, and the whole config still passes. On a scratch copy: a 5.1.0 manifest under packages/core/utils/.cache passes (the script skips it); a 5.1.0 tests/e2e/data/app/package.json fires; a depth-6 template set to 5.61.0 fires; 6.0.0 passes as the other-major control. Passes on the clone.

The regex now counts characters inside the quotes of a '…' or "…" value, or the whole plain value, and fires at 150 or more ('under 150'). Boundary tests on a scratch docs page: 149 passes and 150 fires for plain, single-quoted and double-quoted values. Passes on the clone (max 140).

New cross_file superset rule: every packages/ workspace name must appear among the `package` frontmatter values of docs/docs/packages/**/index.md. The values are read with the strapi-43 frontmatter regex, quoted or bare. Fires on a scratch copy when package: is removed from core/utils/index.md, when it names @strapi/util, and when it appears only in the page body. Unquoted and double-quoted values pass as controls. Passes on the clone (43 of 43).
Comment changed to C, per Stage B. Paths widened from *.md to *.{md,mdx}. An .mdx page with ![](/img/x.png) fires on a scratch copy. Passes on the clone.

New file_content_forbidden rule for raw HTML/JSX tags with no alt attribute or an empty one. Rust regex has no lookahead, so 'no alt' is spelled as a prefix alternation over attribute names; tags that span lines are covered. On a scratch copy these fire: a multi-line with alt removed, alt="", and an .mdx . These pass as controls: uppercase ALT with an extra className, and JSX alt={label}. Passes on the clone (13 tags).
